App

class App[source]

Bases: object

Main application class that initializes and runs the Qt app.

Attributes:
appQApplication | None

The Qt application instance used for the event loop.

splashSplashScreen | None

The splash screen displayed while the application starts.

language_viewQDialog | None

The language selection view instance (not set by run, which uses a local variable).

main_viewQMainWindow | None

The main application window.

help_key_filterHelpKeyFilter | None

Application-wide F1 handler, active in every window.

Methods

run()

Create the Qt application, initialize the language, show the splash screen and the main window, and run the event loop.

Methods

run

Start the application and run the Qt event loop.
run()[source]

Start the application and run the Qt event loop.

Notes

Steps:

  1. Install the global exception hooks and log the start.

  2. Register the qthelp URL scheme (before the QApplication).

  3. Create the QApplication (name, version, icon) and install the F1 help filter.

  4. Detect the initial language (get_initial_language) and install it as a preview.

  5. Show the splash screen. On the first run (no configuration file), the language dialog is shown; rejecting it exits with status 0, and a different choice is applied and saved.

  6. Show the main window and run the event loop.

This method does not return: it ends with sys.exit and the exit code of the event loop, which is logged.
